title: Sobolev mixing constants and compactness in rational moduli space
summary: We study uniformity of Sobolev mixing estimates for rational maps and uniformly quasiregular mappings. For rational maps of fixed degree, the optimal centered Sobolev trace constant $A_f$ is a continuous proper function on Möbius moduli space. Uniform bounds on $A_f$ therefore characterize relative compactness in moduli, and a minimizing class exists in every degree.
